mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows patients to append notes (outcome = Permitted). The LeastPrivilege assertion checks that patients can never append with a permitted outcome; without this constraint, Alloy finds a counterexample.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientAppendAllowed { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.accessor_role = Patient and ae.operation = AppendOp and ae.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact decouples notes from audit entries. The AuditCompleteness assertion requires exactly one audit entry per permitted note; without this constraint, a note can exist without a corresponding audit.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteWithoutAudit { some note: ClinicalNote | no (ae: AuditEntry | ae.operation = AppendOp and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.note_id = note.note_id) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows clinicians to read records without being on the care team. The assertion requires that permitted clinician reads have authorisation_basis = CareTeamMember; without this constraint, clinicians bypass the care-team gate.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClinicianBypassCareTeam { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.accessor_role = Clinician and ae.operation = ReadOp and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.authorisation_basis != CareTeamMember }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows multiple audit entries to share the same audit_id (representing mutation/deletion). The AppendOnly assertion requires all audit IDs to be unique; without this constraint, audit entries can be overwritten.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditId { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.audit_id = ae2.audit_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows patients to have permitted read access with any authorisation basis, not just PatientOwn. The assertion checks that permitted patient reads have authorisation_basis = PatientOwn; without this constraint, patients can access records they don't own.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientAccessOther { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.accessor_role = Patient and ae.operation = ReadOp and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.authorisation_basis = PatientOther }
